all.source_quote: Age requirement: Applicant must be at least 18 years old

unmodelled.text: Minimum 8th pass required for projects costing above Rs 10 lakh in manufacturing sector and Rs 5 lakh in service sector
unmodelled.source_quote:
Educational qualification: Minimum 8th pass required for projects costing above
Rs 10 lakh in manufacturing sector
Rs 5 lakh in service/business sector
Income criteria: No income ceiling for assistance

unmodelled.text: Only new projects are eligible; existing units are not eligible
unmodelled.source_quote: New enterprises only: Scheme is applicable only for new projects; existing units are not eligible

unmodelled.text: Eligible sectors are only manufacturing and service/trading units
unmodelled.source_quote: Eligible sectors: Only manufacturing and service sector projects are covered

unmodelled.text: Excludes units already receiving subsidy under other government schemes
unmodelled.source_quote: Units already availing subsidy under other government schemes are not eligible

unmodelled.text: Excludes institutions such as private limited companies, partnership firms (in some cases), and large enterprises
unmodelled.source_quote: Institutions like private limited companies, partnership firms (in some cases), and large enterprises are generally not eligible

unmodelled.text: Priority given to SC/ST/OBC, minorities, women, ex-servicemen, differently-abled persons, and candidates from rural/hilly areas
unmodelled.source_quote: Priority categories: Special preference is given to SC/ST/OBC, minorities, women, ex- servicemen, differently-abled persons, and candidates from rural/hilly areas

unmodelled.text: Applicants can be individuals (including rural and urban unemployed youth), SHGs, societies, co-operative societies, or charitable trusts
unmodelled.source_quote:
Who can apply:
Individuals (including rural and urban unemployed youth)
Self-help groups (SHGs)
Institutions registered under Societies Registration Act
Production co-operative societies
Charitable trusts

ambiguous: Education requirement is tied to project cost thresholds, which cannot be expressed with the available fields
